item.title: Friday Morning, Nov 27
item.description:
The Black Friday morning bulletin from Gumshoe News Radio for November 27, 2026: Branchburg, New Jersey weather with the full seven-day forecast; hundreds of thousands still without power after the Thanksgiving storm, and President Trump tells troops victory over Iran is at hand as new files suggest the CIA waterboarded more detainees than it admitted; a Houthi strike kills a worker at a Saudi refinery as Pakistan hosts Saudi and Turkish defense talks, and Zelensky warns of another mass Russian attack; an in-depth markets look at a big tech rebound in futures ahead of a half-day session, oil, gold, yields and Black Friday spending; Musk expands his SpaceX share giveaway and a former Palo Alto Networks manager alleges inflated sales; AI shopping agents fall for fake deals and ElevenLabs eyes a thirty-three billion dollar valuation; an unpatched Cacti flaw and poisoned Windows utility downloads; your X feed; storm cleanup and holiday weekend events in Somerset County; and a Baltimore Thanksgiving tradition saved. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
